command: set -Eeuo pipefail; H=$(hostname); test "$H" = 'ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein' || { echo WRONG_HOST:$H; exit 77; }; LIVE=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual; W=/home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-avatar-go/c0dd67ea; test -d "$LIVE"; mkdir -p "$W"; rm -rf "$W/candidate"; mkdir -p "$W/candidate" "$W/evidence"; cp -a "$LIVE/buehne.html" "$LIVE/buehne_daemon.py" "$LIVE/filmlook.js" "$LIVE/zustand.json" "$W/candidate/"; printf '%s\n' 'go-c0dd67ea-76ce-46b8-9b8c-f8f1f9485f36' > "$W/MACROCYCLE_ID"; { echo host=$H; echo observed=$(date -Is); systemctl --user show frankenstein-buehne.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p WorkingDirectory -p ExecStart; echo '--- live hashes'; sha256sum "$LIVE/buehne.html" "$LIVE/buehne_daemon.py" "$LIVE/filmlook.js" "$LIVE/zustand.json"; echo '--- candidate hashes'; sha256sum "$W/candidate/"*; echo '--- tools'; for x in claude codex tmux python3 ffmpeg chromium google-chrome; do printf '%-16s ' "$x"; command -v "$x" || true; done; echo '--- resources'; nproc; free -h; uptime; echo '--- relevant workers'; pgrep -af 'claude|codex|franken|buehne|grid|swarm' || true; } | tee "$W/evidence/bootstrap.txt"; test "$(sha256sum "$LIVE/buehne.html"|cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(sha256sum "$W/candidate/buehne.html"|cut -d' ' -f1)"; echo ISOLATED_WORKSPACE_READY:$W
